name: Lodesta wordmark
note: This is the shipping wordmark. The sans explorations in docs/brand/ (Geist Sans, Figtree) were never adopted and are retained as history only.

typeface.source: Google Fonts, SIL Open Font License 1.1
typeface.tracking: -20 font units per gap (upem 2000, approx -10/1000 em)
typeface.warning: The variable default is wght=300 (Light). Regular must be set explicitly.
typeface.shaping: HarfBuzz with kern and liga enabled; glyphs converted to outlines so the SVG carries no font dependency.

derivedFrom.verification: Outline overlaid on the raster at 3066x692: 92.6% intersection-over-union, visually indistinguishable at 164px and 420px render sizes.
derivedFrom.residual: Merriweather was redesigned in 2024; the current variable release differs subtly from the static version the original raster was set in. No axis setting closes the gap fully, and the difference is sub-pixel at every size the wordmark renders.

valance.rail: y 160 to 290 font units below baseline (130 units thick)
valance.principle: Scallop pitch, not scallop count, is the shared constant with the compact mark. The compact mark uses 3 scallops because its field is near-square; the wordmark uses 5 because it is roughly 3.5x wider. Both hold the 0.46 depth ratio and both attach the scallops to a solid body rather than leaving them detached.

exports.usage: Marketing header and footer via components/MarketingShell.tsx

openItems: No dark-canvas variant exists. Marketing is currently locked to light mode, so this is not yet blocking.
public/lodesta-logo.png is now unreferenced. It is retained as the original artwork of record; delete it only deliberately.
